meta.title: SkillCheck
meta.description: No CV, no cover letter. Show your skills in a short in-person skill check and meet companies at City of Espoo events.

landing.title: No CV. No cover letter. Just show your skills.
landing.subtitle: Take a short skill check in person, in a City EXAM room. Earn SkillCheck badges and meet the companies you want to work for at City of Espoo recruitment events.

steps.title: Choose an event and companies
steps.text: See which companies come to the next City of Espoo event and what each one asks for.

steps.title: Book an EXAM room time
steps.text: 30 minutes on a City computer, up to three skill checks in one visit. If a job needs a licence, card or course, for example for machinery or driving, add it to your profile before booking and bring the original.

steps.title: Take a short skill check
steps.text: An AI interviewer asks about real work situations. Answer in Finnish, Swedish or English, by voice or text. Personal details are removed first, and the feedback shows whether you have the basics for the job.

steps.title: Get badges, meet companies
steps.text: Companies see the feedback and decide whether to meet you. City staff check unclear cases. Accepted checks become badges on your event card and a 15-minute meeting at the event.

candidate.title: Jobseekers
candidate.text: No CV or cover letter to write. Companies see how you work, not your name or photo, until you choose to share.

company.title: Companies
company.text: Meet people who have already shown the skills you need. Less screening, better conversations.

city.title: City of Espoo
city.text: Evidence-based events at scale, with human review and a full audit trail.

privacy: AI models give evidence-based feedback. City staff check unclear cases, and companies choose who they meet.
Personal details are removed before any AI sees or scores your answers.
Scored on what you can do, never on accent, grammar, age or origin.
Checked in person, so nobody can cheat with AI.
